subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 67 (Dilemma cards (teacher's printable: air, cave, lost friend, storm))
intro: Lesson 67: Dilemmas a diver might face: discussing choices and consequences. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

cards: Your air is running low, but a rare creature is right in front of you.
A narrow cave has a glint of treasure inside.
Your buddy signals for help far away.
A storm is coming as you reach the wreck.

keywords.def: a hard choice between two options
what happens because of a choice

questions.q: Give a consequence of entering the cave
questions.a: For example: you might get stuck

questions.q: Give a good side of leaving the treasure
Core: choose a dilemma and write 2 choices with their consequences
Extend: decide what your character chooses and why
questions.a: For example: swims to the buddy, because friends come first

questions.q: Stretch: add a twist consequence nobody expects
questions.a: For example: the buddy has found a way out of the cave

options: Choosing a red or blue towel
Saving your friend or saving the treasure
questions.a: B) Saving your friend or saving the treasure. It is a hard choice where both options matter and have consequences.
